Messages.Author: LSJ

So tap BtV. You've already untapped it with HoS.

If you've tapped it in the meantime and find that it's tapped when you go to
handle its card text, then sure, you'd have to burn a pool.

Messages.Author: frubeng
Messages.Body:


Maybe reading the card might help:

Bleeding the Vine
Unique master.
Put this card into play. During your untap phase, tap this card or
burn 1 pool. You may tap this card to cancel a non-out-of-turn master
card played by another Methuselah as that card is played. That card
has no effect (no cost is paid), and that Methuselah gains another
master phase action
